_note: Every primitive the launchpad offers, with the evidence for each status. `deployed` is read off app/src/config/sepolia-deployment.json; `route` off the <Route path=> lines in app/src/App.tsx. `thread` is the showcase-threads-per-primitive status and is the only hand-maintained field: written | drafted | not-started.

primitives.name: ERC-404 bonding curve
primitives.what: Buyers move along a curve; price rises as supply sells; the collection graduates into a real pool and trades.
primitives.tithe: 19% at graduation, on the whole raise, before a wei reaches the pool. The curve itself is fee-free.

primitives.name: ERC-1155 editions
primitives.what: Open or capped editions at a price you set.
primitives.tithe: 19% on every withdrawal of mint proceeds. Nothing is taken after that.

primitives.name: ERC-721 auctions
primitives.what: One piece, one auction, your reserve.
primitives.tithe: 19% at settlement of each auction, on the winning bid, after your reserve returns to you.

primitives.name: Alignment vaults
primitives.what: You pick the community your work draws from and one of its vaults. The vault holds or LPs that community's token; your share is converted into it. Never custodial to the protocol.
primitives.tithe: The 19% itself. RevenueSplitLib fixes 1/19/80 with no setter.

primitives.name: Requesting a target
primitives.what: If the community you want to align to is not listed, you can ask for it onchain.

primitives.name: The alignment hook
primitives.what: A graduated ERC-404 pool on Uniswap V4 can carry a hook that taxes the ETH side of every swap — buys and sells alike — into the vault. A protocol switch, not a creator setting.
primitives.tithe: Perpetual. The tithe does not stop when the mint does.

primitives.name: Free-mint allocation
primitives.what: Give away part of the supply.

primitives.name: Merkle allowlists
primitives.what: Restrict a mint to a specific list of addresses, proved by a merkle root rather than a server.
primitives.note: Deployed per collection that opts in, not as a protocol singleton — so it is not in the deployment record.

primitives.name: Token tiers
primitives.what: Hold more, get different art. Tiers resolve onchain rather than a server deciding what you are owed.

primitives.name: Artist overlay
primitives.what: Your metadata, your resolver. Host the art where you like, put it onchain, or launch with none and add it later.

primitives.name: The board
primitives.what: An onchain message board. A collection is not an island.

primitives.name: Profiles
primitives.what: An onchain profile per address, readable by anything.

primitives.name: Curations
primitives.what: The one discovery surface a visitor reaches without anyone paying for a slot.

primitives.name: The featured queue
primitives.what: Paid promotion, priced onchain and visible as a queue rather than an arrangement.

primitives.name: The derivative census
primitives.what: Real derivative collections measured on chain, against what their parent community would have received had they launched aligned.
